limits.description: Some GitHub operations cannot be performed by installation tokens and require user-to-server OAuth (e.g., user-level profile updates, starring repos, following users)
limits.workaround: Request user OAuth when needed; store user token alongside installation token
limits.product_implication: Profile README updates and user-level operations require OAuth grant

limits.description: Installation access tokens expire after 1 hour; apps must regenerate tokens. Enterprise installation tokens cannot be scoped down.
limits.workaround: Automatic token rotation with expiration tracking; cache token and regenerate when approaching expiry
limits.product_implication: Long-running operations must handle token refresh transparently

limits.description: Push protection for custom patterns requires GitHub Advanced Security which is enterprise-only
limits.workaround: Use standard secret scanning; push protection limited to GHAS customers
limits.product_implication: Secret boundary manager features may be tier-limited

limits.description: GitHub Actions has free minute limits; Relay CI operations could exhaust minutes if not rate-limited
limits.workaround: Track workflow minutes; add throttling; warn before exhaustion
limits.product_implication: CI operator modes must include cost governance

limits.description: GitHub API rate limits: 5000 requests/hour for authenticated users, lower for installation tokens per repository. Secondary rate limits may apply.
limits.workaround: Implement rate limit tracking; backoff; batch where possible; use conditional requests
limits.product_implication: Bulk operations must be throttled; observability on rate limit consumption required

limits.description: GraphQL API has point-based rate limiting separate from REST; complex queries may exceed limits
limits.workaround: Calculate query cost before execution; paginate; use REST fallback

limits.description: Webhook payload maximum size is 25 MB; larger payloads may be truncated. Some large PR or push events may exceed this.
limits.workaround: Use webhook as trigger only; fetch full data via API
limits.product_implication: Event-driven ops must re-fetch data via API, not rely on payload completeness

limits.description: No API endpoint to discover a user's profile README repo name; convention is {username}/{username}
limits.workaround: Hardcode convention as primary; fall back to user input
limits.product_implication: Profile README automation may need repo name input

limits.description: Some GitHub Pages custom domain operations require repository admin or are not available via API
limits.workaround: Document manual steps; leverage Pages API for core operations
limits.product_implication: Full Pages automation may require manual intervention for domain setup

limits.description: Merge queue functionality is in limited beta and may not have stable API support for GitHub Apps
limits.workaround: Watch for GA; use PR merge API in the meantime
limits.product_implication: Auto-merge pipeline may be less reliable until GA

limits.description: Projects v2 API is still evolving; some operations may be GraphQL-only or have limited App support
limits.workaround: Use GraphQL API for Projects v2; test permission compatibility
limits.product_implication: Project board automation may need workarounds

limits.description: Organization audit log API requires GitHub Enterprise; not available on free/team plans
limits.workaround: Simulate audit trail from webhook events for non-enterprise users

limits.description: GitHub Packages publishing via GitHub Apps may require additional write:packages permission which is separate from repo permissions
limits.workaround: Request write:packages permission explicitly; test package registration flow
limits.product_implication: Package release operator needs explicit package permission

limits.description: Issue forms (YAML-defined templates) are partially supported through the contents API but not via dedicated API
limits.workaround: Manage issue form YAML files via Contents API
limits.product_implication: Issue template management works through file API
